name: Authenticator
summary: Two-factor codes for the accounts you use
description: Keep time-based one-time codes on your phone. Add accounts from setup files, an image, or the keypad.
author: thooton

changes.text: An unreadable vault on the phone is never taken as empty and saved over; late work after the app closes is dropped.
Common: setup files written whole from any thread, leftover setup files cleaned up, and every app on common bumped.
The command center's kept list goes with its setup (signed out, on this phone only, or another command center).
The photo provider's authority follows the package, so a test build installs beside the app.
Set up on the phone, keeping the accounts on this phone only or on a command center; no login built in.
Build and publish immutable Wave package releases alongside the legacy channel.
Turn Android backup on in every app, so adb backup can move their data to another phone.
Back leaves the account form in one press, and the menu always shows Delete and Command center.
The add form moves with Up and Down and keeps what you typed.
